findings.message: Outside this check: compounds.c1.iast spells the member as 'kṣaran' (nilimpa-...-nirbhara-kṣaran-madhūṣṇikā-...), but structure, vigraha and words.w3.padaccheda use the stem kṣarat. The structure grouping itself passes: ((…mallikā-nigumpha)-(nirbhara-kṣarat))-(madhu-uṣṇikā))-manohara matches the vigraha 'तासां निगुम्फात् निर्भरं क्षरन्ती मधूष्णिका, तया मनोहरः'.
findings.suggested_fix: Use 'kṣarat' in compounds.c1.iast to match the structure, or confirm that the iast field is meant to show the surface form.
